items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Cats like – all those cats who came out of here like – you had a lot of cats: Andrew Hill, Herbie Hancock, Jack DeJohnette. Did all those cats come up through your thing too?
Jack used to play piano with me. Herbie didn’t, but Jack did.
Where did Herbie come from? He came up in a different kind of way?
